exceptions.rationale: The upstream project has no patched release. RAG Studio uses only an embedded PersistentClient with a fixed embedding implementation and does not start or expose the vulnerable Chroma HTTP collection-creation API.
compensating_controls: Only the authenticated RAG Studio API is exposed; no Chroma server process, route, or port is published.
Embedding model identity and remote-code settings are fixed by trusted configuration and cannot be supplied by an API request.
The container runs as an unprivileged user, uses a single-node storage lease, and rejects untrusted collection identifiers.
CI validates this exception on every run and fails closed on its expiry date or when the exact dependency pin changes.
